name: preparation
prompt:

Restrained deep slate gray and desaturated blue-gray shadows, natural neutral mineral highlights, no colored objects, soft broad studio light from upper left, gentle directional grazing light revealing actual microstructure. Medium-low key exposure but clear subject, moderate contrast, physically plausible honest material imperfections, sharp detailed focal plane, modest natural depth of field. Close-up real material fills entire frame, simple editorial industrial composition, no architecture or buildings, no text, letters, labels, branding, packaging, watermark, decorative objects, montage, diagrams, dramatic spotlights, 3D render or surreal AI shapes. No people or hands. Landscape 1536x1024.
Subject: Concrete priming: close close-up of a small unbranded neutral gray short-nap paint roller on a fine porous mineral concrete wall, roller sleeve near the upper-right third, attached normal metal bent shank partly exiting right edge. A broad transparent primer trail behind the roller visibly darkens and consolidates the pores, with the untreated fine porous matte surface next to it; subtle moist satin vs dry mineral difference, no liquid puddles or exaggerated drips. The roller and absorption into the substrate should immediately communicate surface preparation. Not opaque paint, not coarse aggregate.
